I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 19 November. He said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.

I didn't open #north-team to check or fix his earlier post. Any correction there is his to make. The date isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel.
